menu.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: final 16:9 landscape illustration for an existing fantasy roguelite game's main menu, not a UI mockup. Input image 1 is the APPROVED MASTER STYLE: the silver-braided elderly woodland quartermaster portrait. Input image 2 is the EDIT TARGET, existing menu illustration. Completely redraw image 2 so EVERY character and the environment are illustrated by the same artist as image 1. Preserve only the useful composition and adventure content of image 2: quiet dark forest on the LEFT 40 percent reserved for live title and menu buttons, party grouped in the RIGHT 55 percent, distant mossy crown arch and winding forest path, treasure chest with a few coins. Replace the square-headed vinyl toy / 3D rendered characters with expressive hand-painted fantasy people matching image 1: visible white and iris in almond-shaped eyes, strong brows, angular noses, sculpted cheeks, warm faces, clear individual personality, stylized compact heroic proportions. Front character is a young adult woodland lord with brown hair, small golden crown, rich red cloak, ivory and old-gold armor and a sword; behind are an adult spear soldier, sword-and-shield soldier and armored rider. The reference grandmother is the STYLE guide, do not turn every character into her. Make the lord's expressive head large enough to read in a menu. Exact style: richly drawn 2D faceted gouache/vector illustration, confident crisp contour shapes, deliberate large angular planes of color, broken hand-painted polygon shadows, graphic gold edge light, tactile restrained painted texture, like the grandmother's hair, face, cloth and leather. Deep petrol teal shadows, moss/olive greens, vermilion cloth, warm cream and burnished gold. Redraw landscape in the same bold painted language, simplified dramatic foliage, avoid fussy photoreal environmental rendering. Warm left rim light with cool right shadow planes. No 3D CGI/plastic surface, no Funko/block heads, no black capsule eyes, no photorealism, no UI, text, lettering, logos, frames or watermark. Full bleed opaque 16:9 image, at least 1536x864. Keep left 40 percent low detail and dark for readable real game menu; keep important faces entirely in right half and clear of bottom edge.
